cat_sofa_to_play_nov09.title: From a Quiet Sofa to a Cat's Busy Day
cat_sofa_to_play_nov09.script: A cat rests on a sofa, but stillness is only one part of its daily routine. In a different home, another cat explores a paper bag and peers into the opening. Outside, a black cat walks across the ground, while a separate cat carefully cleans its fur. Two cats play together indoors, while another cat rolls and stretches on the floor. Elsewhere, a young kitten rests on a bed, offering a quieter moment between the other scenes. Finally, a cat enjoys a person's gentle attention outside, closing this story on a calmer note.
cat_sofa_to_play_nov09.caption: FROM SOFA REST TO PLAY. Original narration over independently filmed real cats. Sources and creators credited with each approved release. #WildVox #Cats #CatBehavior

red_squirrel_walnut_to_branch_nov09.title: A Red Squirrel's Route From Food to Trees
red_squirrel_walnut_to_branch_nov09.script: On a stump, a red squirrel handles food while balancing above the ground. Nearby in another recording, a squirrel investigates walnuts scattered on the wood. Other red squirrels pause on a city ledge and among branches, watching their surroundings. Two separately filmed squirrels travel around park trees, using the trunks and branches as pathways. An English red squirrel pauses in a different tree, taking in the scene. Finally, one climbs a trunk, connecting the search for food with the movement between trees.
red_squirrel_walnut_to_branch_nov09.caption: A RED SQUIRREL'S DAILY ROUTE. Real squirrels filmed in different woodlands and cities. #WildVox #RedSquirrel #Wildlife

kingfisher_bill_feather_perches_nov09.title: What Makes a Kingfisher Stand Out?
kingfisher_bill_feather_perches_nov09.script: Bright blue feathers draw attention to this common kingfisher, but its long pointed bill is equally distinctive. In another view, a kingfisher preens its feathers while staying on a perch. Different birds pause beside water, turning and watching from their separate resting places. At two more waterways, branches and greenery frame these small birds as they remain perched. A more distant kingfisher stays near its own patch of vegetation, harder to pick out. Even from farther away, the small silhouette and pointed bill can reveal where the kingfisher sits.
kingfisher_bill_feather_perches_nov09.caption: BLUE FEATHERS AND A POINTED BILL. Distinct real common kingfishers filmed beside different waterways. #WildVox #Kingfisher #Birdwatching

canada_goose_shore_family_nov09.title: How Canada Geese Travel With Their Young
canada_goose_shore_family_nov09.script: Tiny Canada goose goslings gather beside an adult, keeping their family group close. Another family travels together in a different location, their small bodies moving alongside adults. One gosling stops to forage among plants, exploring the ground within its reach. Elsewhere, a family walks near the shoreline while other young goslings rest in a separate scene. On two park waterways, older Canada geese paddle through the water in separate groups. A parent and gosling appear together once more, closing the journey with a familiar family sight.
canada_goose_shore_family_nov09.caption: GOSLINGS ON THE MOVE. Separate real family scenes, from shoreline to open water. #WildVox #CanadaGeese #Wildlife

european_robin_seasonal_perches_nov09.title: A Robin's Small Stages Through the Year
european_robin_seasonal_perches_nov09.script: A European robin pauses on a garden fence, its orange breast easy to recognize. Another robin perches in a winter park, surrounded by bare and quiet branches. In spring and summer, separate robins appear among low branches and leafy park greenery. By early autumn, another robin pauses in a different part of the park. Two robins sing from reeds in separate recordings, turning small perches into places for song. Finally, a robin sings again in a different view, ending with the sound that makes this bird memorable.
european_robin_seasonal_perches_nov09.caption: ORANGE CHEST, WINTER PERCHES AND REED SONGS. European robins across real locations. #WildVox #Robin #Birdwatching
